title: Should You Buy Comcast Stock Because Its Cash Outruns Its Earnings?

The stock trades at 0.7 times sales, its own ten-year low. The number that argues the other way is not an earnings figure. Free cash flow over the last twelve months ran at about 159% of reported net income.
